category_definition: The model misattributes properties or actions across entities mentioned in competing contexts, or fails to resolve ambiguous third-person pronouns (he, she, they) across sentence boundaries.
The claim and evidence align on entities and predicates but contradict on exact dates, calendar years, temporal intervals, or numerical cardinalities.
The claim involves abstract hypernyms, compound modifiers, or pragmatic inferences (e.g. former implies left) that cannot be verified by surface word overlap or single-step NLI.
The retrieved Wikipedia passages fail to contain necessary context for genuine ground-truth facts due to BM25 ranking bias, passage window truncation, or missing entity background.
